mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scheduler_job_statuses WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduler_job_statuses SET is_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE scheduler_job_statuses SET last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, last_run_ok = #{lastRunOk}, last_run_status = #{lastRunStatus}, last_run_error_message = #{lastRunErrorMessage}, last_duration_seconds = #{lastDurationSeconds}, total_runs = COALESCE(total_runs, 0) + 1, total_failures = COALESCE(total_failures, 0) + CASE WHEN #{lastRunOk} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
